dict.string: TrainTime needs your location to find nearby Swiss train stations, show departure times, and work out how long it takes you to walk to the platform.

While you are tracking a departure, TrainTime uses your location in the background to keep your walk margin and your leave-by countdown correct on the Lock Screen, and to time a saved route's reminder to your distance from the station. It stops when you stop tracking, and you can turn background tracking off in Settings.
TrainTime uses Bluetooth to reach a paired Garmin watch through the Garmin Connect app, so tracked departures can be sent to your wrist.
